Summary of what the pinned tree supports: the earlier vault hardening is present (CLI `os.umask(0o077)` at `lib/ansible/cli/vault.py:145-146`, `mkstemp` at `lib/ansible/parsing/vault/__init__.py:853`), but the guard is incomplete — `write_data` unlinks and re-opens the temp by name (`1076-1082`), so the library route bypasses it and the recreated inode is both umask-dependent and raceable; the post-editor failure paths (`868`, `878`) never shred the plaintext temp; `DataLoader` has a second decrypt-to-temp implementation (`dataloader.py:323-335`) outside the private `DEFAULT_LOCAL_TMP` convention; and `shuffle_files`/`rekey_file` (`1094-1097`, `1020-1022`) carry the must-keep-working mode/ownership coupling. Four independent fix groups, usable as a stacked task.
